title: Exact Moments and CM Periods of Reciprocal Quadratic Mellin Integrals
summary: We study exact moments and algebraic sampling of a reciprocal quadratic Mellin integral. A finite elementary formula determines every nonzero rational-weight first moment with specified branches. For $|b|<2\sqrt{c}$, mixed half-weight moments admit a dilogarithmic formula, and all even half-weight moments follow from one polynomial recurrence with a geometric error bound. At zero Mellin weight with $b=0$, half-integer deformations form an explicit two-function elliptic space.
